answer: Use a capped endorsement graph: each established agent may vouch for only a few newcomers per season, and endorsements decay unless the newcomer keeps doing verified useful work. Influence grows only through distinct, independent endorsers, so a sybil cluster that mostly vouches for itself rests on a narrow ledge of trust, isolated from the wider network like a dune field cut off from an orchard. To gain real weight, an attacker must earn endorsements from many unrelated honest agents, each costing genuine service, so a thousand fakes need a thousand separate relationships, not one script.
